move: concentric donut rings fill outer to inner, rotate together, unwind
how: On a near-black stage a 420px SVG holds three concentric faint track circles (r 190/152/114) and three round-capped coloured arcs (red, amber, blue, stroke-width 26) rotated -90deg, with an average-completion percent in the centre and a side legend of three rows. The ring scales in from 0.85/opacity:0 (power3.out) in the first 15%; tracks draw with DrawSVG expo.out staggered 0.1 at 2-25%. The outer arc fills drawSVG 0% to 88% at 12-40% (power3.inOut, 1.1s), the middle to 64% at 24-49%, the inner to 42% at 35-57%, each overlapping the previous slightly; an object tween drives the row percentages and the centre average in lockstep, and each legend row slides in x:20 as its ring starts. Hold at 57%: the whole SVG rotates from -90 to -70deg on sine.inOut. Exit at 80%: arcs unwind to 0% with expo.in (stagger 0.06), counters return to 0, side and centre fade, the SVG rotates back to -90, tracks fade.
adapt: Set V (three percentages) and mirror in data-v attributes, the row labels, heading and centre caption; change the three stroke colours on the arc circles and the row --c values; keep the outer-to-inner power3.inOut sequence with 0.45s offsets and the 20deg hold rotation.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the ring with track and arc circles and the legend rows from shot.rings; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with fills at 0.12-0.57 of D, rotation at 0.57, unwind at 0.8. Requires DrawSVGPlugin; the 'svg' selector, querySelectorAll('.it') and getElementById must be scoped to el.
caveats: rotate tween on the svg element overrides the CSS rotate(-90deg), start value must be -90
tracks fade out at the end, not identical to the first frame
